title: How to Build a Newsletter App With AI (Own Your Platform, Keep 100% of Revenue)
summary: Build a newsletter app with AI in one weekend — subscriber management, paid tiers, analytics, and email delivery included. Own your data, keep every dollar.
body_markdown:
When Blink asks, paste your live Stripe publishable and secret keys (from your Stripe dashboard) — Blink only accepts live keys, not test ones. Prompt: "Create monthly and annual subscription plans with a Stripe checkout flow. Add a webhook handler that syncs subscription status back to the subscriber record in real time."


Blink generates the full Stripe integration — checkout sessions, webhook handler, and subscriber plan updates. Auth is built in, so the subscriber portal works with the identity system from the first prompt.


Correctly implementing Stripe subscriptions — checkout, webhooks, status sync, failed payment recovery — takes a solo developer 2–3 days. With Blink: 20 minutes.
